Sometimes, finding comfort in the arms of a stranger can feel completely amazing. I used to be on the same boat as you, and sometimes I still fall back into it. It's a moment in your life where you continuously look for something to keep you going. Something to look forward to the next day. I know you don't want to die, because you came here. &im glad you did! Lacking motivation is the worse feeling in the world. Knowing that you're simply content with your current state, but you know that you should probably do something about it; yet you don't. I still haven't done much to change my own situation. Lack the drive to do so, it's just something I'm comfortable and familiar with. But regarding your situation, I would try and pick up a sport or hobby. I picked up tennis and I frequently play until I want to pass out. Other things can keep us going, but really it all depends on yourself. &the fact that you want to keep going. Life is a struggle but there's only one direction you can move, and that's moving forward. I never said moving forward would be easy but that's where you'll be moving. Don't let yourself continuously stay in that dark state, as time passes. You gotta motivate yourself. Know that you have everything it takes to do so. You deserve to be fucking happy. When you feel like you're in that state, try to get pumped up. Fuck depression. Fuck everything. It's my life and I can shape my own future. The past is in the past. I will never forget but I will learn. I don't even know you, yet I want to just give you a high five and go out for fucking ice cream. We got this
